title: Transformer-Based Masked Diffusion Models Provably Learn Distributions with Latent Structure
abstract: arXiv:2610.12544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate discrete data by iteratively unmasking multiple tokens in parallel using a learned mask predictor. Their output carries two errors: parallelization error due to parallel sampling, and estimation error from the mask predictor learned with finite samples. Existing theory treats these errors separately, and the available statistical bounds typically scale with the number $V^L$ of length-$L$ sequences over a vocabulary of size $V$, suffering from the curse of dimensionality. In this work, we establish end-to-end statistical guarantees showing that transformer-based MDMs learn structured distributions with a sample complexity governed by their latent structure. Specifically, we model this structure through mixtures of hidden Markov trees, which capture latent dependencies within components and heterogeneity across components. translated_title: 基于Transformer的掩码扩散模型可证明地学习具有潜在结构的分布
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散模型（MDMs）通过使用学习到的掩码预测器迭代地并行解除多个词元的掩码来生成离散数据。其输出包含两类误差：由并行采样导致的并行化误差，以及由有限样本学习掩码预测器所产生的估计误差。现有理论将这两类误差分开处理，且已有的统计界通常随词表大小为 $V$、长度为 $L$ 的序列总数 $V^L$ 而扩展，饱受维度灾难之苦。在本工作中，我们建立了端到端的统计保证，表明基于Transformer的掩码扩散模型能够学习结构化分布，其样本复杂度由数据的潜在结构决定。具体而言，我们通过隐马尔可夫树的混合模型来刻画这种结构，该模型能够捕捉组份内部的潜在依赖关系以及组份之间的异质性。当数据分布能够被此类混合模型很好地近似时，基于Transformer的……
tldr: 本文首次为基于Transformer的掩码扩散模型建立了端到端统计保证，证明其能以由潜在结构（隐马尔可夫树混合模型）决定的样本复杂度学习结构化离散分布，突破了以往理论中 $V^L$ 维度灾难的限制。
en_tdlr: This work establishes end-to-end statistical guarantees showing that transformer-based masked diffusion models provably learn structured distributions with sample complexity governed by their latent structure (modeled as mixtures of hidden Markov trees), circumventing the $V^L$ curse of dimensionality in prior bounds.
